extracted.intended_audience: credentialed sports media (beat reporters, broadcasters, wire services) and team/public-relations staff
extracted.subtask_description: Arena- and team-specific media access instructions, contact listings, and logistical guidance for credentialed journalists covering NBA games (will call, media entrance, parking, press contacts, practice-facility directions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance location and opening time
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies where the press/ media entrance or press gate is located at the arena and when it opens relative to game start (examples: TD Garden — press gate on east side on Legends Way; press gate will open three hours prior to the start of the game; Spectrum Center — media entrance opens two and a half hours prior to tipoff; United Center — media may enter through Gate 3-1/2 on the northeast corner).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always state the gate name/location (e.g., 'east side on Legends Way', 'Gate 3-1/2'). Include the scheduled opening time relative to game start (e.g., 'three hours prior', 'two and a half hours prior'). If the page lists multiple venues, include the specific entrance + opening-time pair for each venue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Will Call / Ticket pickup location and instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Where credentialed media or ticketed personnel pick up tickets (examples: TD Garden — Will Call window located at the Ticket Service Center on the East Side of TD Garden across from the entrance to the Executive Offices and the East Elevators; United Center — Tickets can be picked up at Gate 4 inside the East Atrium).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give exact building location and nearby landmarks (e.g., 'across from entrance to the Executive Offices', 'inside the East Atrium, Gate 4'). Note any specific window name (Will Call, Ticket Service Center) and hours if provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking availability and reservation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates whether press/media parking is available, where it is located, and reservation/credential rules (examples: Barclays Center — no press parking at the arena and recommended to use public transportation; Spectrum Center — Media Parking located across from loading dock on N. Caldwell Street; United Center — All credentialed media may park in Lot A; parking must be reserved in advance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether parking exists, the lot name/location, and whether advance reservation is required. If no press parking is available, explicitly recommend alternatives (public transit/nearby garages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Directions and recommended transit routes to arenas and practice facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Driving and public-transit directions to arena and practice-facility locations (examples: TD Garden — directions from Logan Airport via Sumner Tunnel to North Station/TD Garden; Barclays Center — lists multiple subway lines and LIRR with most convenient stops; HSS Training Center — accessible via D, N, R subway lines to 36th St and also by car via I-278 W Exit 23).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide major highway or airport approach, toll notes, recommended lanes, and specific transit lines/stops. Where applicable, call out that public transit is the fastest/most convenient option.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press room / PR department contact information and hotlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Team PR and press-room phone numbers, fax numbers, PR office emails, press-hotline numbers, and social/X accounts (examples: Nets PR phone/fax/PR emails, Celtics PR departmental numbers and hotline, Hornets PR office and press-row PR line).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List main PR office number, press-room/pr hotline, fax, PR department emails and the team's PR/X handle. When multiple contact types are provided include all (office, cell, fax, hotline).

rubrics_metrics.name: Credential/parking linkage and credentialed-media privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural requirement linking credentials to privileges such as parking or access (example: 'All credentialed media may park in Lot A located on Washington Blvd. Parking must be reserved in advance.' i.e., parking access is limited to credentialed media and requires reservation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state which privileges require credentials and any advance actions required (e.g., reserve parking). If credentials determine lot access or other privileges, record that dependency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice-facility location and access guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Directions to team practice facilities and guidance about parking/access (examples: Auerbach Center directions from Mass Pike exit 17 toward Newton/Watertown with turn-by-turn directions; HSS Training Center address and subway lines; note about street parking or paid lots available around Industry City).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full address, primary transit lines, highway exit details, and any parking notes (street parking, paid lots). Include whether the facility is separate from the arena and how to reach it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact-email formatting conventions for media directories
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows the preferred/displayed email-address formatting for team contacts, used repeatedly to instruct media how to form addresses (examples: '(WSBTV E-mail: first name.last name@wsbtv.com)', '(WPIX E-mail: firstinitial lastname@pix11.com)', '(Projo E-mail: firstinitial last name @projo.com)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record the published pattern(s) for the organization (e.g., 'first.last@domain', 'firstinitiallastname@domain', 'firstinitial_lastname@domain') so reporters can construct emails when direct addresses are not listed. Note any explicit spacing/format instruction in the directory (preserve punctuation: dots, hyphens).
